captured_from: SYNTHETIC (not a container capture): the correct `protocol_version` byte (0x0a, HandshakeV10) followed by an incomplete, non-NUL-terminated `server_version` string ("8.4" with no trailing NUL) -- the same shape as `crates/bathy-interpret/src/rules.rs`'s own `mysql_handshake_v10_rejects_a_missing_nul_terminator` unit test. Models a real failure mode: a packet truncated by a read cap or a hostile/broken peer before the version string's terminator arrived.
